declarative.why: names the property holding this map's own tile URL template (and optionally <property>Attribution)

notLower.why: the tile source is app configuration (a property), and the generator resolves it into tilesUrl/attribution at generation time; a map cannot compute its own tiles

twice.note: ONE APP ONLY: ride-hailing `drivers-map` with property driversTilesUrl (+ driversTilesUrlAttribution), added 2026-11-18.

enforced.note: ExperienceEmitterTest asserts the emitted map.tilesUrl; drive_s2.py asserts the drivers-map carries the property's URL. The tiles themselves loading in a browser (Leaflet) has NOT been checked for this property.
